obs: "The only property exempt from levy is that listed in 6334 (a) of the 1954 Internal Revenue Code, 26 U. S. C. (Supp. V) 6334 (a), consisting of certain personal articles and provisions. It does not exempt salaries or wages."
United States v. W. M. Webb, Inc.

“Additionally, 26 U. S. C. 3121 (b) (4) provides an exemption for service by aliens on foreign vessels, and 3306 (c) (17) exempts fishermen on vessels that do not exceed 10 tons in displacement. These provisions raise the inference that fishermen on larger vessels were expected to be covered, under the general ‘common law rules’ provision.”

“The enumeration contained in 6334(a), Congress directed, is exclusive: ‘Notwithstanding any other law of the United States . . . , no property or rights to property shall be exempt from levy other than the property specifically made exempt by subsection (a).’”
